english: Let $\overrightarrow{a}$ and $\overrightarrow{b}$ be vectors such that $|\overrightarrow{a}|=3$, $|\overrightarrow{a}+\overrightarrow{b}|=4$ and $(2\overrightarrow{a}+\overrightarrow{b})\times(\overrightarrow{a}-2\overrightarrow{b})=20\hat{i}-40\hat{j}+40\hat{k}$. Then the value of $(\overrightarrow{a}+\overrightarrow{b})\cdot(3\overrightarrow{a}-2\overrightarrow{b})$ is ______.
hindi: माना कि $\overrightarrow{a}$ तथा $\overrightarrow{b}$ ऐसे सदिश हैं कि $|\overrightarrow{a}|=3$, $|\overrightarrow{a}+\overrightarrow{b}|=4$ तथा $(2\overrightarrow{a}+\overrightarrow{b})\times(\overrightarrow{a}-2\overrightarrow{b})=20\hat{i}-40\hat{j}+40\hat{k}$ है। तब $(\overrightarrow{a}+\overrightarrow{b})\cdot(3\overrightarrow{a}-2\overrightarrow{b})$ का मान ______ है।
solution_full: Expand the cross product using $\overrightarrow{a}\times\overrightarrow{a}=\overrightarrow{b}\times\overrightarrow{b}=\overrightarrow{0}$ and $\overrightarrow{b}\times\overrightarrow{a}=-\overrightarrow{a}\times\overrightarrow{b}$:
The double root gives $p=-9$ uniquely, and then $s=7+18=25$, that is $|\overrightarrow{b}|=5$ (consistent: $9\cdot 25-81=144$).
originality_note: New: the cross product of two linear combinations reduces to -5 a x b, and Lagrange's identity together with |a+b| collapses to a perfect square (p+9)^2 = 0, so a.b and |b| are both forced although |b| is never given (way 4, hidden invariant). Closest known: given |a|, |b| and |a x b|, find a.b. Different because: |b| is unknown and is recovered only through the double root.

concept_use.Application of dot product: |a+b|^2 = 9 + 2 a.b + |b|^2 and the final expansion (a+b).(3a-2b) = 27 + a.b - 2|b|^2.
concept_use.Application of cross product: Bilinearity and anti-commutativity reduce (2a+b) x (a-2b) to -5 a x b, giving |a x b| = 12.
concept_use.Lagrange’s Identity in Vectors: |a x b|^2 = |a|^2|b|^2 - (a.b)^2 gives 9s - p^2 = 144, which with s = 7 - 2p forces (p+9)^2 = 0.

stem_review: Read as a student: every vector, line and point is introduced before use, every condition is stated, each sentence has one reading; the answer was recomputed independently with sympy and numpy, is unique and equals the Answer Plan. Checked that the data are consistent (explicit vectors a, b built and tested) and that a.b is unique (double root). Changed: No change.
key_step: Reducing (2a+b)x(a-2b) to -5 a x b, then combining Lagrange's identity with |a+b| to get the perfect square (p+9)^2 = 0.
justification: Two ideas linked: cross-product algebra and Lagrange's identity, with the unknown |b| eliminated through a double root that a student must notice is unique. Comparable to the unit-vector data puzzle 2021-P1-Q19 (L3); more than the direct magnitude chain of 2026-P2-Q1 (L2).
